sources_considered.why: Original survey offers relevant managerial attitudes, but does not match qualifying replacement opportunities to actual dismissals.
Search result concerns AI use and anticipated job displacement, not the stated conditional staffing decision.

evidence_items.explanation: This survey cautions against assuming uniform enthusiasm for replacement. It does not identify the author's managerial archetype or establish how respondents acted after encountering a qualifying higher-return replacement.

The survey does not establish the antecedent and resulting staffing behavior for the same managers.
